description: The items of the UBL example world: what each party sells, goods and services, with identifiers, customs tariff codes (HS), units (UN/ECE Rec 20), packaging (Rec 21), weights and prices in the seller's currency. Goods carry a world item number issued by the identifier issuing agency (#31). A resold item points to the original.
